userai-desc: Provides wiki-managed assistant guidance and selected Semantic WikiSchema reads
userai-denied: User AI is disabled or this account is not authorized to use it.
userai-unavailable: The requested User AI operation is unavailable.
userai-not-found: The requested entity could not be read.
userai-connection-required: A valid User AI supervisor approval is required.
userai-connection-unavailable: This request expired, does not exist, or is unavailable to your account.
userai-connection-details: Assistant: $1. Registered OAuth application: $2 (key ending $3). Verification code for this request: $4.
userai-connection-awaiting-supervisor: OAuth sign-in succeeded. The supervisor must now approve the connection. On their device, the supervisor can load a wiki page while signed in and open the approval request in the UAI banner.
userai-connection-pending: This connection is waiting for your approval. Approve only a connection you just requested yourself.
userai-connection-approved: The connection has been approved. You can close it from this page.
userai-progress-check-app: No newer status has been received for at least one minute. Please check the AI app.
userai-progress-decision: Decision required in the AI app
userai-progress-invalid: The UAI progress update is invalid or too long.
userai-order-review-unavailable: This order is unavailable to your account or the request has expired.
userai-order-review-saved: The decision is saved. You can return to the chat.
userai-order-review-feedback-length: The requested change is too long.
